senses.gloss:
mfn. (-त्सन्-त्सन्ती-त्सत्)
Wishing to eat.
E.
अद to eat, desiderative form, शतृ aff.

f. (-त्सा)
Hunger.
E.
अद to eat, in the desiderative form, अङ् and टाप् affs.

mfn. (-त्सुः-त्सुः-त्सु)
Hungry.
E.
see the preceding, affix उ.

f. (-सा)
Wish or intention to kill.
E.
हन to kill, desiderative form, अङ् and टाप् affs.

mfn. (-सुः-सुः-सु)
Mischievous, murderous, seeking to hurt or kill.
m. (-सुः)
An enemy.
E.
हन to kill, &c. in the desiderative form, उ aff.

mfn. (-सन्-सन्ती-सत्)
Wishing to kill, murderous, felonious.
E.
हन to kill, desiderative form, शतृ aff.

mfn. (-यान्-यसी-यः)
Very desirous or determined to kill.
E.
जिघांस, and इयसुन् aff.

mfn. (-क्षन्-क्षन्ती-क्षत्)
Desirous to take, greedy, avaricious.
E.
ग्रह to take, desiderative form, शतृ aff.

f. (-क्षा)
Greediness, covetousness, wish to seize or take.
E.
ग्रह to take, desiderative form, अङ् and टाप् affs.

mfn. (-क्षुः-क्षुः-क्षु)
Wishing to seize or take.
E.
ग्रह to take, desiderative form, उ aff.

mfn. (-घ्रः-घ्रा-घ्रं)
Smelling, who smells.
E.
घ्रा to smell, श affix, root reiterated.

mfn. (-घ्रन्-घ्रती-घ्रत्)
Smelling.
E.
घ्रा to smell, शतृ aff.
